2607.11506.title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
2607.11506.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes LLMs using sparse verifiable final-answer rewards. This sparse anchor reliably verifies whether a trajectory succeeds but provides no direct feedback on the reasoning path that produced it. Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain Optimization with Process Efficiency), a two-stage framework that densifies this anchor while retaining the GRPO update: Adaptive Scaffolded RL adds prefix-decomposed verifiable rewards on answer-hidden sub-question chains before success, and Quality-Aware Process RL applies correctness-gated process-shape rewards to refine correct trajectories after success. An expert-validated Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol evaluates useful-step density, error localization, and token efficiency beyond final-answer accuracy. On Qwen3-8B-Instruct trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math, SCOPE-RL improves average accuracy by up to 11.2 pp and reduces reasoning tokens by up to 27.1% over outcome-only GRPO; the gains hold under GSPO and on Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct, indicating that reward-signal densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tokencraft-lab/SCOPE-RL.
2607.11506.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR）利用稀疏的可驗證最終答案獎勵來優化大型語言模型（LLMs）。這個稀疏的錨點可靠地驗證了一條軌跡是否成功，但對產生該軌跡的推理路徑並未提供直接反饋。在成功之前，對於困難問題的先決進展不會收到獎勵信號；在成功之後，結果獎勵無法有效區分組織良好的正確軌跡與冗餘或局部有缺陷的軌跡。我們引入了 SCOPE-RL（帶有過程效率的支架鏈優化），這是一個兩階段框架，旨在在保留 GRPO 更新的同時加密這個錨點：自適應支架 RL 在成功之前，對答案隱藏的子問題鏈添加前綴分解的可驗證獎勵，而質量感知過程 RL 在成功之後，對正確軌跡應用正確性門控的過程形狀獎勵以精煉正確的軌跡。一個經專家驗證的步驟質量評估協議評估有用步驟的密度、錯誤定位和超越最終答案準確性的標記效率。在基於 DAPO-Math 和 Big-Math 訓練的 Qwen3-8B-Instruct 上，SCOPE-RL 將平均準確率提高了最多 11.2 個百分點，並將推理標記數量減少了最多 27.1%，相較於僅依賴結果的 GRPO；這些增益在 GSPO 和 Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct 上仍然有效，表明獎勵信號的加密是對策略更新層級 RLVR 進展的補充。代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/tokencraft-lab/SCOPE-RL 獲得。
